Gorbals

Citizens Theatre

One of Scotland’s flagship producing theatres, the Citz has been making bold, uncompromising work in the Gorbals since 1945. Following a landmark restoration, it reopened with stunning new studio spaces alongside its iconic Victorian auditorium. Known for its European spirit, bold reimaginings of classic texts and championing new Scottish voices.
